items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: and I practiced it, and then I played it practically note for note like Trumbauer did.

ctx.x: to a saxophone (of course I had played it before) was when Bix Beiderbecke came out with "Singin' The Blues," with Frankie Trumbauer playing that C-melody. That's the record. "Singin' The Blues" was the name of it, and "Ida, Sweet As Apple Cider" -- that record just set everybody off.
Where did you hear that? Around here?
